name: any-grid
title: Any Grid
description: A seven-tile bento board on black where the layout never moves and every card is alive instead — a scan column sweeping a token chart, counters easing and scrambling into place, cycling tool icons and action rows, a portrait swapping with its badge, breathing bars, and a collaborator's cursor dragging a selection across the closing line. Starts when the board scrolls into view, then loops.
